_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. Names carry their own units and scope: `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party (best member — see PartyBonuses), a bare name is flat. Six were wired 2026-09-12 and left this list. Of the rest: effect_duration_pct DUPLICATES a live mechanic (Enchantment duration is already computed from skill level in _calculate_status_duration, so wiring it would double-count), and trap_detection_pct has no system to hook into at all — see TODO on traps. The remainder each need their own consumer written.

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
